evaluation.positive_opportunity: First executable post-alert path reaches +5% before -5% adverse excursion.
evaluation.late: At first executable price, most catalyst repricing is already consumed or gate returns LATE.
evaluation.failed_entry: BUYABLE_NOW then -5% adverse excursion occurs before +5% favorable excursion.
evaluation.insufficient_data: Required point-in-time tape fields cannot be verified; excluded from gate precision denominator.

anti_overfit: No threshold or rule edits until the 100-case batch has been fully scored. Proposed changes go to v2 only after v1 results are frozen.
